name: Minimal Elephant
body:
Minimal Elephant
CR 4

XP 1,200
Variant elephant
N Small animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +21

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)
hp 71 (11d8+22)
Fort +11, Ref +10, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +13 (1d4+4), slam +13 (1d4+4)
Special Attacks trample (1d4+6, DC 23)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 7
Base Atk +8; CMB +11 (+13 bull rush); CMD 24 (26 vs. bull rush, 28 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance, Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+8 to jump), Perception +21
Languages –

ECOLOGY

Environment warm plains
Organization solitary or herd (6–30)
Treasure none

Minimals are small versions of normally Medium, Huge or Large sized animals and beasts. Any animal or generally animal-like beast (GM’s discretion) can become a minimal.

Dinosaurs and their ilk are most commonly found as minimals on isolated islands in the Mediterranean where entire miniature pre-historic eco-systems can be found.
